prediction.keyboardOwner: wireComboboxes on the currently open picker root
prediction.rationale: The badge text and title use the same computed signal, which reads the currently selected count. Stable row objects and DOM keys preserve the editor, and the update restores focus and selection if a DOM move disturbs them. Per-row selection signals update the attributes directly. Each open picker has one wiring instance, and closing disposes it before removing its root.
